headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5.6, emphasizing cost-efficiency gains in enterprise AI
body: OpenAI has released GPT-5.6 with a stated focus on improving price-performance metrics for commercial deployment. For healthcare organizations evaluating large language model integration into clinical workflows and EHR systems, cost efficiency directly impacts ROI on AI-driven documentation, coding, and decision support tools. The release comes as healthcare systems increasingly pilot foundation models for administrative and clinical tasks, making the economics of model selection a critical factor in vendor evaluation. However, real-world performance reports indicate reliability concerns that consulting teams must validate before recommending production deployment in regulated healthcare environments.
